STS2_THINGS-FEATURE_CUSTOM_BGM_ENABLED.h: Disable to restore the original game music while keeping combat sound effects. Can be changed during combat.
STS2_THINGS-BOSS_ONLY_MOD_BOSSES.hover.d: Choose only enabled bosses from this mod in their supported acts. If none are available, keep the original boss pool. Forced bosses take priority. Existing maps are not rerolled.
STS2_THINGS-MULTIPLAYER_POLICY: Multiplayer settings follow the host. Gameplay locks when the run starts; the host can still change music. Leaving restores your preferences.
THINGS_CROSSROADS_DESCRIPTION: A few locked side paths appear on the map. Reach either end to unlock one for 50 Gold. The confirming player pays; the entire party gains access.
